method_findings: (a) V2 is a cadence-jitter effect, not long staleness: 99.7% of the 2352 steps with age in (2,5] are on slow drives (71% of all steps; 238/398 slow vs 7/167 fast drives affected); native median dt 1.41 s slow vs 0.82 s fast, p90 1.78 s so k=2 sits just above normal slow polling; age >5 s only 41 steps, so the 15-row ffill is not the main driver. Removed steps: drop 3.5-5.5 km/h vs ~2, lower speed (20-29 vs 37), lower mean charge current (2-11 vs 15 A), ratio falls monotonically with age (66.6, 60.8, 33.9, 25.2, 17.3, 8.3 %). Within-drive pairs confirm (age<=1 vs 2-5: 72.3 vs 32.6, 37 drives). Mechanism: multi-second speed change booked as one 1 s step with a single-second charge. The gradient continues below k=2: slow-drive steps whose previous-row speed is not fresh in its bin (about 22% of steps) have ratio 42-54% vs 69-82% when fresh, and V2 does not touch them, so V2(2) is a partial, threshold-dependent trim of a cadence bias that affects every slow-drive step; k is arbitrary and the retained set is not cadence-free. Age is referenced to bin end s+1 for a bin mean, about 0.5 s conservative.

(b) V4 bin5 is not only a binning artefact: legacy bin5 = A (start<10, n 15673, 46% KE, 8% of charge, ratio 1.63, 97% zero charge, mean drop 1.6 km/h, 51% of steps are a 1 km/h quantum) + B (start>=10 and end<10, n 4566, 54% KE, 92% charge, ratio 16.6, mean start 11.4 km/h, 99% start<20). The legacy 9.7% is B-dominated threshold-crossing steps at the regen fade-out; V4 is by construction one-directional (33% of KE moves up, none down) so bin-by-bin deltas compare different populations. Wholly sub-10 steps recover little but are limited by 1 km/h speed resolution.

(c) Sign: logged I is charge-positive (mean +22.7 A engine-off decel, -35.0 A accel, rest speed 0 engine-off median -3.06 A in 563/563 drives). v6 states the offset as charge-biased (net draw accumulates negative), so I_log + i_off with i_off<0 lowers charge: sign consistent. Rest periods cannot confirm the offset (true aux load unknown, rest draw 3 A vs 0.39 A offset); offset is coupled to CAP_KWH (0.15 A/kWh) and assumed constant additive, applied to short 20-100 A charge pulses.

(d) Unit slips in the claim (steps vs KE); V2 intervals not combined with mass range; thin bins 0-10 C (1 day, n 46) not evaluable; V4 delta is not comparable-bin; the bar value rises under V2 yet cadence bias also in retained set.
